correctness.rationale: For odd n, A=I+cyclic_shift has determinant 2. Under y=1-Ax the odd-cycle inequality sum x<=(n-1)/2 becomes sum y>=1; the violating region is exactly the full y-standard simplex because all its vertices invert to feasible x>=0, edge-compatible points. Jacobian gives cap volume 1/(2n!). Trace of the Hilbert--Schmidt kernel 1_{u+v<=1} raised to odd n gives ambient volume from eigenvalues 2(-1)^j/((2j+1)pi) and secant-number beta identity. The cap has Dirichlet coordinates; alternating centered exponential partial sums obey a functional CLT, and inverse A produces the antiperiodic Brownian bridge-like process B(t)-B(1)/2. Its covariance 1/4-|s-t|/2 is inverse to antiperiodic Laplacian with double odd-frequency eigenvalues. The spectral determinant yields sech(sqrt(s/2)), and finite Dirichlet second moments yield n/[4(n+2)]. Independent exact/numerical linear algebra checked det(A)=2, all n+1 simplex vertices feasible and finite mean n=5,7,9,11. This finite test does not replace functional convergence.
residual_risks: Convergence is in distribution, not almost sure; q law only for uniform points conditional on violating integrality, not the full polytope sample.
